system.description:
Touch; casting takes 10 minutes. One willing dead creature, dead no longer than 1 week, of which you hold a body part. It returns in a new adult body of a random ancestry (roll randomly among the available ancestries), keeping its class, level and memories; its ability scores change to match the new ancestry's bonuses and penalties. It returns with 1 HP, 3 levels of Exhaustion and no spells prepared. No save. Material: rare oils worth 1,000 gp, consumed.

Costly component: see Rare Spell Components in the Shopkeeper's Catalogue.

Classes: Druid, Witch
